subject: RapidePay performance goals & onboarding test schedule
messages:
From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@rapidpay.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: RapidePay performance goals & onboarding test schedule

Hi Mina / Ben / Monica,

Thanks again for the onboarding kickoff yesterday. We want to lock down performance targets and a concrete test schedule so our SREs can align their throttles and traffic mirroring. Quick context on our side: production peak for the new chat assistant is ~220 rps sustained (peaks to ~380 for short bursts), payloads are mixed (short prompts ~40 tokens; multimodal embeddings calls ~1–2k tokens occasionally).

High-level asks:
- Can Redwood propose a runbook that covers a ramp -> soak -> spike sequence we can run in our preprod cluster?
- We need explicit acceptance criteria (p95/p99 targets by endpoint and error budgets) to sign off.
- Can we run the soak during the weekend window Mar 18-19 if that works for you?

Attached a small traffic sample we redacted (rapidepay_traffic_sample.json). Also happy to join a short sync to confirm telemetry hooks.

Thanks,
Sarah Lin
Director, Platform Reliability
RapidePay

--
Attachment: rapidepay_traffic_sample.json (JSON, 28KB)
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@rapidpay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RapidePay performance goals & onboarding test schedule

Thanks Sarah — this is great context.

Proposed plan (high level):
1) Kickoff verification (Mon Mar 15): sanity checks, keys, telemetry verification, and a short smoke run to validate connectivity and sample rates.
2) Ramp test (Tue Mar 16): 30 minutes ramp from 10 rps to target sustained (we'll use 220 rps as baseline).
3) Soak test (Sat Mar 18, 02:00–08:00 UTC): 6-hour soak at sustained 220 rps with intermittent 10-min 380 rps spikes to observe tail behaviour.
4) Spike & recovery (Sun Mar 19): two controlled 10-minute spikes to 500 rps (to test graceful degradation and fallbacks).

Acceptance criteria (draft):
- Chat endpoint (v1/chat): p95 latency < 150 ms; p99 < 400 ms; error rate < 0.5% over the soak window.
- Embeddings endpoint (v1/embeddings): p95 < 120 ms; p99 < 300 ms; error rate < 0.5%.
- 99% of requests must meet their p95 target over the soak (i.e., success if 99/100 samples under p95).
- KV/prefix cache enabled for chat (to be used during all runs). Batching will be kept at customer-config default unless we agree to test custom batching.

We attach a template runbook you can fill in with exact traffic mixes (redwood_onboard_benchmark_template.xlsx). Ben/Monica: can you confirm instrumentation endpoints (metric names + log endpoints) we should consume? Also confirm whether RapidPay will mirror traffic or generate synthetic requests — both are fine but we need clarity on headers and auth.

If the weekend soak works, we’ll put the full plan into the shared Drive and I'll create a short post-run evidence checklist for signoff.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of Customer Success — Onboarding
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: redwood_onboard_benchmark_template.xlsx (XLSX, 14KB)
From: Tom Chen <tomc@rapidpay.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@rapidpay.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RapidePay performance goals & onboarding test schedule

Mina — thanks for the quick proposal. Weekend soak (Mar 18) works on our side. A few clarifications:
- Confirming peak sustained target: 220 rps for chat baseline, with 10-min spikes to 380 and occasional simulated bursts up to 500 for recovery tests.
- We will run synthetic traffic from our preprod SRE runners and will mirror 10% of production traffic for a shorter validation run on Mar 16 if helpful.
- Traffic mix: ~75% chat, ~25% embeddings by request count. Average chat request size: ~45 tokens; embeddings average payload ~1k tokens.

We'll upload an updated traffic matrix and the SRE runbook to the shared Drive by EOD tomorrow.

Tom Chen
Staff SRE, RapidePay

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tom Chen <tomc@rapidpay.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 13 Mar 2028 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RapidePay performance goals & onboarding test schedule

Great — looping in a few implementation details from our side.

Test harness & telemetry notes:
- We will ingest your prometheus metrics endpoint (please expose scrape target /metrics-preprod) and a short-lived ingestion token. Metric names we’ll look for: redwood.request.duration.p95, redwood.request.duration.p99, redwood.request.errors.total, redwood.request.count.
- Please add the header x-rp-test-id to synthetic traffic so we can correlate logs.
- Run commands (example):
  - ./rbench --target https://preprod.redwood.com/v1/chat --qps 220 --duration 6h --mix chat:75,embeddings:25 --headers \"Authorization: Bearer <token>,x-rp-test-id:RP-2028-042-A\"
- Evidence we need after run: raw request trace samples (first/last 30s of soak), aggregated p50/p95/p99 CSV, error logs for any 5xx. I created a quick matrix (attached) to capture expected fields: rapidpay_target_matrix.csv.

I'll also drop a short link to the HubSpot deal where we’ll attach the post-run artifacts: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DP-98765

Ben Carter
Customer Success Engineer
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: RapidePay performance goals & onboarding test schedule

Thanks all — summarizing agreed items and next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Agreed schedule:
- Mar 16: Short mirror run / smoke checks (connectivity + telemetry verification). Time: 10:00–11:00 PDT.
- Mar 18 (UTC window 02:00–08:00): 6-hour soak at 220 rps with two planned 10-min spikes to 380 rps.
- Mar 19: Spike & recovery checks (two 10-min controlled bursts to 500 rps).

Final acceptance criteria (agreed):
- Chat (v1/chat): p95 < 150 ms, p99 < 400 ms, error rate < 0.5% over soak.
- Embeddings (v1/embeddings): p95 < 120 ms, p99 < 300 ms, error rate < 0.5% over soak.
- Overall pass: >=99% of requests meet their p95 target and no unexplained 5xx spikes greater than 0.2% above baseline.

Deliverables & evidence to collect after the soak (for signoff):
- Aggregated CSV for p50/p95/p99 by 1-minute buckets.
- Top 20 trace samples for any requests above p99.
- Error log extract and a short incident narrative if any threshold is missed.
- A single PDF pack (rapidepay_benchmark_plan_v2.pdf) that contains the filled template, test commands, and telemetry endpoints.

Operational notes:
- Ben: we will use the x-rp-test-id header as the primary correlation key.
- Monica: will own the run and be the on-call for the soak window (monica.patel@redwood.com).
- Tom/Sarah: please upload the final traffic matrix and the SRE runbook to the Drive folder by EOD Fri Mar 16.

If everyone is aligned I’ll publish the runbook to the shared Drive and create the HubSpot artifact for signoff once the evidence is attached. Also linking the SOW docusign for the reserved soak window: https://www.docusign.com/s/RP-SOW-2028

Thanks — talk soon.

Mina Haddad
Head of Customer Success — Onboarding
Redwood Inference
